assets.prompt: Create a RED SANDSTONE material variation of this approved natural cliff wall game asset. Preserve its overall width, height, framing, front-facing elevated orthographic 2.5D camera and painterly rendering. Change the GEOLOGY, not just the colors: warm muted terracotta red sandstone with visible irregular horizontal sediment layers, eroded ledges, broad weathered angular slabs and chipped edges. Different rock arrangement with mixed large and small masses, no identical pillars, no regular bricks, no flat texture wallpaper, no low-poly triangles. Narrow bare stony upper lip, no green vegetation. Natural broken rock feet, no detached objects. Same upper-left light and approximately same relief depth as reference. One continuous wall completely visible, green margin around it. Opaque solid bright chroma green #00FF00 background. No water, ramps, stairs, cave, arch, buildings, trees, text, grid, transparency or checkerboard. Not a tile atlas or complete mountain.

ONE continuous wall with same relief and scale as reference, not a mountain or atlas. Whole subject visible against opaque solid bright chroma green #00FF00 background. No ramps, stairs, caves, arches, props, text, checkerboard, transparency or external ground shadow.

Mixed large and small rock masses with believable depth, subtle darker grey recesses, no black dramatic cracks, no identical pillars, regular bricks, low-poly triangles or flat stone wallpaper. Solid opaque chroma green #00FF00 background, no transparency/checkerboard. No ramps, stairs, cave holes, arches, detached rocks, structures, water, text or grid.
